name: flash
title: Flash
description: A ring that shows where a link has landed, then fades.
use: Anything a link can point at among many like it: a heading, a row, a comment, a card. When its id is the fragment of the address, a ring of ink stands around it for two seconds. It also keeps the element clear of a bar fixed at the top of the page: set --flash-offset to that bar's height.

instead.when: Words are emphasized where they stand, for as long as they are there
Something happened and the reader should be told

classes.name: flash
classes.description: On an element with an id: when it becomes the target of the address a ring stands around it and fades away, following the element's own corner

states.name: target
states.description: The element's id is the fragment of the address: the ring shows and fades. With reduced motion a hairline stays around it instead

properties.name: --flash-offset
properties.description: How far below the top of the viewport the browser scrolls the element to
